content: Hara asal afa pirddippate
«Yinttal afa pirddinttaamay garkk hara asal afa pirddippate.
Abis giiko, hara asal afa yi pirddizay garkk yinttal afa pirddoda; yi hara asis makkeez bazar yinttis mahii makinttoda.
Ne aafe yez tuussa be7ekkazar ne ishay aafe yez buuxa abis be7ee?
Ne aafe tuussi yezin ne ishay aafe yez buuxa kesso goddayis wayizii danda7ee?
Neno cubbayyo, tiinatii ne aafayid yezi tuussa kessoba. Ezaypp guye, ne ishay aafayid yez buuxa kessodayis ne milxi udii be7ada.
«Guye maaqqii yinttan dhaqamay garkk geesh baz kanitayis olippatte. Fa tokayir yedhdhii iissamay garkk yi al7o inqqu gududayllitay tiina olippatte.
Woossoytta, kozhoytta, xeegoytta
«Woossoytta yinttis ingginttoda, kozhoytta yi demmada, bale yi7ii xeegoytta yinttis dooyinttoda.
Woossiza ooskka ingginttoda, koyiz ooskka benttoda, bale yi7ii xeegiz ooskka dooyinttoda.
«Yinttapp na7a daabbo woossiko shuchchi inggizay oonoo?
Woy molo woossiko shooshi inggizay yenee?
Yeezin yi iititay yi na7itayis lo77o baz imo eriko, salo yez yi aday fana woossizittays lo77o baz wayizii gaanthii inggaamo?
Yhankkitay yinttis oothod garkk yi kozhiz baz ubba yinttikka hara asis oothoytta. Abis giiko, Muse higgaynnee nabittay tamaarssizay yhaya.
«Un7a penger geloytta; dhabo kanggiz ogay damma, pengaykka dalgge. Ezayir geliza asaykka gaame.
Zin de7oko kanggiz ogaynnee pengay un7a; ezayir geliza asaykka xiqqa.
Mithii fa aafer erinttiza
«Afa baggar dure aazii ganccer fuge maaqqii bonqqodayis yi gancce geliza wordo nabitaypp naaginttoytta.
Yi unttan, u aafayir eroda; angguthapp woynnee, gijjepp balase maxinttoya.
Yey garkk lo77o mithii ubbay lo77o aafe aafiza; iita mithii iita aafe aafiza.
Lo77o mithii iita aafe aafooya, ma iita mithii lo77o aafe aafodayis danda7ooya.
Lo77o aafe aafowa mithii ubbitay gachchinttii tama gancce olinttoda.
Yey gishos, yi unttan, u aafatir eroda.
«Salo yez ta aday azazo oothiza athay salo kaatetithii gelodaypp attin cer tana ‹Godayyo, Godayyo› giz ubbay salo kaatetith gelooya.
Ye wode gaamitay, ‹Godayyo, Godayyo, ne sunthar tinbbite nu odekkasa? Ne sunthar tuna ayyantta nu kessekasa? Ne sunthar gaame malata nu oothekkasa?› yeegoda.
Ye wode, ‹Ta yinttan yesha erooya, yinttii wucitay taapp haakkoytta› yeegoda.
«Yikee, yha ta qaala si7ii oothiza oonkka fa keetha zaallal afa keexxeez wozinaama as garkke.
Ira bukkeeza, di7o di77eeza, carkkokka carkkii ye keethana urqqeeza. Zin keethay zaallal afa keexxintteez gishos woddekkaya.
Yha ta qaala si7ii oothowa oonkka fa keetha shafel afa keexxeez boozo athay garkke.
Ira bukkii, di7o di77ii, carkkokka carkkii, ye keetha urqqin, ye keethay woddeeza; E woddithaykka woliqqama» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa fa oda wurisseezaypp e timirttay higge asitamaarttay garkk maaqqekka mawuter yez asayisay garkk maaqqiz gishos asay e timirtta yhay malabaz geeza.
